notes: Registry describes all 116 operation contracts; availability distinguishes deployed Cloudflare functionality from future planned operations. Local Rust support alone does not establish remote availability.
security_notes: Every named operation is still checked by a future authenticated application service; a JSON workspace_id is not authorization.
Transient UI commands require a live user-consented UI session and may return UNAVAILABLE without it.
A preview/approval is required for real dependency and graph changes; edge display style is visual-only.
Provider API keys are never arguments to scene, task, companion, or MCP tools.
